CYTOGENETICS LABORATORY REPORT
[redacted name] Medical Center
Department of Clinical Genetics

Patient: [redacted name]
DOB: [redacted date]
MRN: [redacted ID]
Specimen: Amniotic fluid
Collection Date: [redacted date]
Received: [redacted date]
Reported: [redacted date]

RESULT: Normal Male Karyotype - 46,XY

CLINICAL INDICATION
Amniocentesis performed for advanced maternal age (40 years) at 16 weeks gestation. Screening for Down syndrome (trisomy 21) and other chromosomal abnormalities.

TEST PERFORMED
G-banded chromosome analysis of cultured amniocytes

RESULT AND INTERPRETATION
Karyotype: 46,XY

No evidence of trisomy 21 or other numerical or structural chromosomal abnormalities detected. This represents a normal male karyotype.

The analysis quality was sufficient to exclude numerical abnormalities and major structural rearrangements. Minor structural abnormalities below the resolution of conventional cytogenetics (approximately 5-10 Mb) cannot be excluded.

This result supersedes the previous rapid PCR analysis performed on this specimen.

TECHNICAL INFORMATION
Methodology: Amniotic fluid cells were cultured using standard techniques. Metaphase chromosomes were G-banded using trypsin-Giemsa staining. A minimum of 20 metaphases were analyzed at a resolution of 400-550 bands.

Number of cells analyzed: 20
Number of colonies examined: 3
Banding resolution: 450-500 bands

LIMITATIONS
This test cannot detect:
- Balanced chromosomal rearrangements that do not result in gain or loss of material
- Low-level mosaicism (<10%)
- Single gene disorders
- Microdeletions/microduplications below the resolution of conventional cytogenetics
- Uniparental disomy

RECOMMENDATIONS
No chromosomal abnormalities associated with genetic disorders were detected. Genetic counseling is available to discuss these results and any additional testing considerations.

This laboratory is accredited by the College of American Pathologists (CAP) and certified under the Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA).

Reported by: [redacted name], PhD, FACMG
Laboratory Director: [redacted name], MD, PhD
